integrity: All theorem assertions are proved in RESULT.md; standalone symbolic checks corroborate but do not certify the infinite-domain result.
limitations: Scalar quadratic, fixed raw momentum, exactly one active update per period versus independent Bernoulli delivery of equal frequency. title: A sharp momentum crossover between periodic and Bernoulli gradient delivery
